note: All Arthome copy, segmented by theme: interface strings and taxonomy labels alike. One file per theme; each key carries all its locales side by side so a translator sees both at once. Show titles, synopses, bios and chat messages are NOT here: they live in catalogue.json in the language the venue wrote them.
conventions: Store copy in sentence case. Uppercase kickers are a styling choice (text-transform), never a second key.
common.* is shared by every surface — prefer adding there over duplicating per surface.
enums.<type>.<id> mirrors an id in taxonomy.json, catalogue.json or fixtures.js, and is read through A.enumLabel(type, id).
studio-*.json is régie vocabulary: it never appears on a storefront.
taxonomy-*.json resolves the i18n keys declared in taxonomy.json — structure there, copy here.

files.note: Interface publique : actions, navigation, temps, états, découverte, billetterie, lecteur, tchat, compte, télécommande.
Taxonomie : familles, disciplines, genres, tags et attributs transverses. Résout les clés déclarées dans taxonomy.json.
Studio : régie, programmation, équipe et droits, public et modération, recettes et versements.
Transverse aux cinq surfaces : chargement, vides, réseau, erreurs, zone sûre.

surfaces.note: A surface loads only the files it needs: loadArthome({ themes: [...] }). The studio also reads storefront.json for shared actions, time and state labels.
